title: Universal Artifact and Project Intelligence
objective: Map provider state into the multidimensional AgentArtifact model and evidence-based project relationships.

stories.title: AgentArtifact domain implementation
stories.outcome: Implement lifecycle axes, risk, reversibility, confidence, authority ceiling, provenance, and relationships.
acceptance_criteria: Artifact state axes are independent and validated.
No UI/provider-specific field enters the core model.

stories.title: Project attribution evidence model
stories.outcome: Attribute artifacts to projects only through explicit provider metadata, known paths, or strong observed evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Attribution records evidence source and confidence.

stories.title: Orphan and staleness signals
stories.outcome: Derive ORPHANED/STALE signals without directly implying deletion eligibility.
acceptance_criteria: Orphan state and protection state coexist.
Signal explanation identifies evidence and thresholds.

stories.title: Multi-dimensional query API
stories.outcome: Expose machine/project/provider/artifact/session views over one inventory model.
acceptance_criteria: Views do not duplicate source data.
Totals reconcile across dimensions with explicit Unattributed bucket.
